question: Should experimental Claw lifecycle diagnostics be accepted as a core Doctor capability now, or should the lifecycle feature remain outside the core roadmap until the RFC and prerequisite ownership series are approved?
rationale: The implementation introduces a new core diagnostic surface rather than repairing established behavior, and the PR body itself identifies the broader core product-direction decision as unresolved.

options.title: Sponsor the gated core diagnostics
options.body: Accept this slice after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102406 is approved and current-head runtime proof demonstrates the non-mutating Doctor contract.

options.title: Defer the core surface
options.body: Keep the RFC and stacked lifecycle work open but defer this Doctor integration until maintainers settle the long-term Claws product boundary.

options.title: Narrow to existing diagnostics seams
options.body: Request a reduced proposal that exposes only a generic Doctor extension seam if maintainers do not want Claw-specific core behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated core diagnostics
recommendation.body: Accept this slice after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102406 is approved and current-head runtime proof demonstrates the non-mutating Doctor contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This reviewer supplied the most concrete current health-check and state-safety acceptance criteria in the available discussion.
